name: Read AI Palace Great Work deal eligibility and recipient capacity without transfer

condition.code: return Game and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()>=0

steps.code:
local index=0
local from=0
local tag='creator-owned'
local function locations()
  local found={}
  for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do
    for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do
      local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
      for building in GameInfo.Buildings() do
        if buildings:HasBuilding(building.Index) then
          for slot=0,buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(building.Index)-1 do
            if buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(building.Index,slot)==index then
              local workType=buildings:GetGreatWorkTypeFromIndex(index)
              local workInfo=GameInfo.GreatWorks[workType]
              found[#found+1]={Owner=owner,CityID=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),
                Building=building.Index,BuildingType=building.BuildingType,Slot=slot,
                ObjectType=workInfo and workInfo.GreatWorkObjectType or 'unknown',
                Creator=Game.GetGreatWorkPlayer(index)}
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return found
end
local before=locations()
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_SOURCE] tag='..tag..' count='..#before..' expectedOwner='..from
  ..' isHuman='..tostring(Players[from] and Players[from]:IsHuman()))
assert(#before==1,'source count mismatch; no physical transfer: '..tag)
local work=before[1]
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_WORK] tag='..tag..' owner='..work.Owner..' creator='..tostring(work.Creator)
  ..' building='..work.BuildingType..' city='..work.CityID..' slot='..work.Slot
  ..' object='..work.ObjectType)
local empty=0
local unknown=0
local first=''
for _,city in Players[1]:GetCities():Members() do
  local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
  for building in GameInfo.Buildings() do
    if buildings:HasBuilding(building.Index) then
      for slot=0,buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(building.Index)-1 do
        if buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(building.Index,slot)==-1 then
          local slotID=buildings:GetGreatWorkSlotType(building.Index,slot)
          local slotInfo=GameInfo.GreatWorkSlotTypes[slotID]
          if not slotInfo then unknown=unknown+1 else
            for match in GameInfo.GreatWork_ValidSubTypes() do
              if match.GreatWorkObjectType==work.ObjectType
                and match.GreatWorkSlotType==slotInfo.GreatWorkSlotType then
                empty=empty+1
                if first=='' then first=city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()..':'..building.BuildingType..':'..slot end
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
local possible='unavailable'
if DealManager and DealDirection and DealItemTypes
  and DealManager.GetWorkingDeal and DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems then
  local ok,working=pcall(DealManager.GetWorkingDeal,DealDirection.OUTGOING,from,1)
  if ok and working then
    local read,items=pcall(DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems,from,1,DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,working)
    if read then
      possible='missing'
      for _,item in ipairs(items or {}) do
        if item.ForType==index then possible=tostring(item.IsValid);break end
      end
    else possible='read-error' end
  else possible='working-unavailable' end
end
local after=locations()
assert(#after==1 and after[1].Owner==work.Owner and after[1].CityID==work.CityID
  and after[1].Building==work.Building and after[1].Slot==work.Slot,
  'read-only Palace probe changed the original')
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_READ] tag='..tag..' index='..index..' expectedOwner='..from
  ..' emptyCompatible='..empty..' unknownSlotTypes='..unknown
  ..' first='..first..' dealItemValid='..possible)
assert(work.Owner==from and work.BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE'
  and work.ObjectType=='GREATWORKOBJECT_RELIC', 'Palace work source mismatch: '..tag)
assert(work.Creator==(tag=='creator-owned' and 0 or 1), 'Palace creator mismatch: '..tag)
assert(tag~='acquired' or (Players[from] and not Players[from]:IsHuman()),
  'acquired Palace work is not AI-owned: '..tag)
assert(empty>=1 and possible=='true', 'recipient capacity or deal eligibility mismatch: '..tag)
return 'AI Palace source and recipient capacity recorded without physical transfer: '..tag
